## About
Bridgetown Automotive is family owned and operated by Chris and Krissy Ryser. Chris grew up on a farm fixing the tractors, trucks and cars that kept it running, then went to work at a local dealership before opening his own shop here in Milwaukie.
Our team does the work. Jed Miller handles suspension and brakes, Jon Dayton handles diagnostics and major engine repair, and Eric Call tracks down stubborn electrical problems. Greg Teela, our service manager, looks after our customers and fleet accounts.
Whether you leave here happy or unhappy, we want to know. We stand behind our work, and our customers have rated us 4.9 from 520 Google reviews.

## Services
- Preventative Maintenance: Tune ups, oil changes and regular maintenance so the little things don't become the big things.
- Auto Repair & Services: Check engine light on? We'll take a look and help you sort out minor to major repairs.
- Alignments: An alignment helps your tires last longer, can improve gas mileage and improves handling.
- Heat & AC Repair: A full range of heating and cooling system services.
- Hybrid Vehicle Service: Hybrids need people who understand both the mechanical and electrical side. We've invested in the tools and training to do it right.
- Tesla / EV Service: Diagnostics and maintenance for Tesla and other electric vehicles.
- Diagnostics: We use advanced vehicle diagnostics to find and fix performance problems.
- Digital vehicle inspections: Detailed inspection reports so you can see what's going on with your car and plan ahead.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: All makes and models, foreign and domestic. From a smart car to a motorhome, we have you covered.

Q: Do you service business vehicles?
A: Yes. We offer fleet services with tailored maintenance and repairs to keep business vehicles running with minimal downtime. Greg manages our fleet accounts.

Q: Will I know what the work costs before you start?
A: One customer, Blaine, wrote that we gave him an invoice of what the work would cost before starting, along with a full inspection with detailed pictures.
